stops.segment: The Name After the Man
stops.stop: Marly-le-Roi, death in the house
stops.date_confidence: attested that he died at Marly-le-Roi, then Seine-et-Oise, at the age of eighty; the day is contested and unresolved. fr.wikipedia gives 5 November 1920 and the INHA civil-act tradition gives 4 November 1920, both descending from documentary sources, and nothing consulted adjudicates. The 4 November reading is used here without preference. No burial place was found in any source consulted, which is recorded as a gap and not filled by inference.

stops.segment: The Name After the Man
stops.stop: Avenue Joseph-Bouvard, the name on the Champ-de-Mars
stops.date_confidence: attested: fr.wikipedia's Avenue Joseph-Bouvard gives the naming decision of 18 March 1921, the dimensions of 450 metres by 50, the run from the Place du Général-Gouraud to 35 avenue de Suffren, and the quoted description of the honorand. Coordinates corrected to that article's own figures. The detachment of a roundabout as Place Jacques-Rueff in 1984 is attested by the same article.
